head_commit.message:
fix: statically link CRT on Windows to eliminate VC++ Redistributable dependency

codex.exe failed with STATUS_DLL_NOT_FOUND (0xC0000135) on Windows
systems without the Visual C++ Redistributable installed, because
vcruntime140.dll, vcruntime140_1.dll, and msvcp140.dll were missing.

Adding +crt-static to the MSVC rustflags produces a self-contained
binary with no external CRT dependencies.

Co-Authored-By: Craft Agent <agents-noreply@craft.do>
